retained_overlay.description: 病理 U019 肿瘤总论
retained_overlay.count_compatibility_note: Legacy field name included_in_2514_count is retained for backward compatibility; O9 is excluded from the current numbered_canonical_kps total of 2517.

macro_domain_taxonomy.rule: Macro-domain taxonomy, durable System-owner granularity, and learner route are distinct. A/B/C/D/E/F describe the top-level conceptual grouping. A is specially decomposed into A1/A2/A3 first-class System owners because that decomposition serves exam-scale learning and governance. Macro-domain membership never creates a mandatory learner step or transfers Block/KP medical ownership upward.

macro_domain_logic.owner: supersystems/**/LOGIC.md when a macro-domain actually needs explicit cross-child integration logic
macro_domain_logic.rule: Macro-domain Logic may own only cross-child structural compression, routing semantics, and explicit external interfaces. It may not become a second medical-Core owner, duplicate child Primary content, manufacture learner progress, or require symmetric macro-domain assets where no score utility exists.

system_level.rule: When a same-system system.json exists on Current main@HEAD with Chat-approved semantic authority, it is the single System-level owner. Its lifecycle status (for example CURRENT or FREEZE_CANDIDATE) describes maturity, not permission to revive a parallel guide owner. The same-system guide remains prior substrate/reference only. When no system.json exists yet, the corresponding system guide remains the transitional System-level substrate.

block_medical_core.rule: Block Markdown owns Block/KP medical Core. Each stable Block identity must resolve to exactly one live canonical Markdown owner. Filename suffixes such as v1, v7, or 最终执行版 are legacy packaging/history labels only; they do not create version authority and do not justify a second live owner. Multiple live files resolving to the same stable Block identity are invalid and Current validation must fail closed. Do not rename accepted Block files merely to normalize legacy suffixes, because source-path churn has no semantic value. System-level files may organize, route, compress, or reference Block Core but must not silently override or fork it.

logic_group.rule: Logic groups/framework nodes organize stable Block/KP identities. They are not an independent medical-Core owner.

kp.owner: canonical KP records embedded in the canonical Block owner
kp.rule: Preserve stable KP identity and order. Split, merge, renumber, or semantic replacement requires an explicit Chat-approved content change.

overlay.rule: O9 remains a separately retained overlay and is not counted inside the numbered canonical KP total (currently 2517).

shared_learning_support.guide_resolution_rule: For systems explicitly present in learner/guide-bindings.json, that file is the Current explanatory-Guide path resolver. Legacy system_fields.*.guide_path values in learner/shared-fields.json do not revive retired same-system Guide authority and must not override the Current binding. Systems absent from guide-bindings.json continue through their own Current/transitional system-level resolution.
shared_learning_support.block_preentry_rule: Framework / Memory Routing / MI-G / MI-D are typed learner-support semantics only when explicitly owned by canonical Block Markdown. Missing content remains absent; learner support and Projection may not infer membership for symmetry.
shared_learning_support.rule: Files under learner/ may support Current learning policy, learning projections and stable identity joins. They are not personal learner state and must not become a second semantic owner over system.json, Block Markdown, or canonical KP Core.
shared_learning_support.biochemistry_scoped_contract_rule: Scoped specialization of the Xizong Learning Contract for M1–M10/G1–G5 first-pass Source continuity, reconstruction, Recall, Memory and Content-generation semantics. It owns no medical Core, Question Truth, learner state or Runtime truth.

upgrade_policy.rule: System-by-system v6 upgrades add or update the natural Current owner in systems/** without copying a second semantic truth. Once a system.json exists, the old same-system guide is retained only as reference/substrate unless explicitly removed later.

runtime_rule: Astro may project Current assets but cannot create or override Xizong semantic truth.
